# P36.63 — Records-request drafts on tasks (K11 RQ-04)

Manifest row 406. Branch `r11/P36.63-records-request-drafts`, stacked on `r11/P36.62-task-and-campaign-pages` (the operator retargets to `main`). `live_verification=false` — no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips, no claim-spine write.

## What landed

Records-requester and document-reviewer tasks now render the persisted DRAFT request (SIG-RQ-007): statute and citation, template/table versions, target agency, response deadline, appeal path, the residency note where a state restricts requesters (SIG-TASK-016a/b), the verbatim request text, and the "SIG sends nothing; you file it; the filer is left blank" line. **DRAFT, NEVER SEND** — `status` is always `drafted`, a non-draft row or a nonzero `sent` count fails the build, and there is no transmit path anywhere (ADR-171).

| surface | content |
|---|---|
| `/task/<handle>/` draft block | the full DRAFT — banner, statute/citation, versions, residency, records sought, verbatim body, download, never-send lines |
| `/task/<handle>.draft.txt` | the downloadable `.txt` document (DRAFT banner + body verbatim) |
| `/task/<handle>.json` | `sig.task-page/1` gains `records_request_draft` + `draft_download` |
| `/research-queue/drafts/<place>.txt` | per-place bundle of every draft for the place and its children; `…--part-<n>-of-<m>` splits keep every file ≤ 25 MB (SIG-RQ-010) |
| queue cards, hub Downloads, place pages | "DRAFT request available" badge → the draft block; bundle links only where drafts exist |

The export contract is `sig.records-request-drafts/1` (`web/records_request_drafts.json` — the detector's `records_requests.json` shape verbatim, `sent: 0` always); the fixture-export harness emits it so export-mode builds exercise the same seam.

## Requirements stamped

**SIG-RQ-007** (drafts shown, never sent — owner), **SIG-RQ-010** (queue downloads sharded — owner); cited **SIG-UI-039**, **SIG-UI-040**, **SIG-ENG-042**, **ADR-171**. Plan-cell decision `D-K11-3 [B-22] = yes` carried verbatim (implemented, never re-decided).

## Verification

`npm --prefix web run check` fully green: typecheck 0 errors; unit 1168+ incl. `records-drafts.test.ts` (13 legs — never-send gate, ≤25 MB shard split + cap-refusal); build 426 pages / 428 routes classified / 38 redirect rules; e2e incl. the 7 new RQ-04 legs (draft render, no-transmit-path, residency, named absence, `.txt`, bundle, badge+twin), axe WCAG 2.2 AA, budget, script-policy, nojs-parity, link-crawl sweeps.
